head: d033e02

rows.note: improve.weekly calls evolution.stop_list, which builds #53's five categories from rows and feeds velocity.review. Stale experiments are stopped on the Experiment row; cadence, polish, query and infrastructure stops go to one batched owner card (improve.stop_list:weekly).
improve.sandbox promotes proposals that beat a baseline captured at proposal time, and the promotion is executed (the registry incumbent changes and priority_for reads it).

runner.TRIALS gains league_replay (historical-job replay with holdout) and self_audit (our own product's audit). Proposals go PROPOSED -> TESTING (regression and adversarial tests recorded by sandbox_runner) -> approval by the evaluator -> PROMOTED, then EXECUTORS run. Cells support a per-trial metric, a baseline anchored from the first trial reading, and rejection when the league holds a challenger.

improve.monitor calls runner.monitor_trials, which re-runs each promoted trial on fresh data. If it reads worse: cells.revert, then league.rollback (or the teardown floor is dropped), and a rollback incident is opened.

The improve.replay cadence records league runs for the incumbent and challengers; compare runs in replay and in improve.league; losers retired with their verdict; the winner promoted via the sandbox and rolled back when it reads worse.

bootstrap.register_code_versions (nightly and monitor cadences) versions every gateway prompt, the deterministic tools by source digest, and the gate, spend and tier policies, each recording why it changed, tests, cost and departments. The job-priority scoring policy is versioned and read back from its payload.

improve.consume is read where decisions are made: radar.score nudges the promotion score; the cir.draft enqueue gets a value boost for Pattern Engineering; listing.seo gives a lesson-matched query a tag slot; support.triage attaches lessons to open cases. Each records bus.acted_on.

The runner orders proposals with roi.prioritise (expected_gain). discipline() applies stagnation (3+ assessed promotions with no return opens an improve-stagnation incident and throttles to one trial per pass) and thrash (a cell with 2+ reverts in 30 days is held).
Approved low-risk improvements are executed: the sandbox promotes and runs execute_promoted; rows the tier cooldown holds are picked up by the weekly director.execute_approved.

ideation.select (creative.tournament and expedition handlers) runs standard.meets_standard with a deterministic taste_judge (obvious, derivative_feeling, boring). A taste rejection is final whatever the novelty score; hit_quality is reported.

culture.sweep's route_findings publishes cultural_territory and cultural_timing lessons on the bus; Market Radar (radar.score) and SEO (listing.seo) act on them. Content and Seasonal Planning only receive them. The post-launch weight update needs sales from culture-derived products.

teardown.enforce turns every finding into a binding exceed, prevent or clarify requirement; the teardown.enforce cadence checks every certified product, and the store.publish release gates refuse on unmet or unmeasured requirements.
Chart-benchmark strengths become 'exceed the best benchmark' requirements on the PDF consumer, enforced at publish against our self-audit.
Beginner traps bind the PDF (publish gate) and Pattern Help; support.triage calls apply_pattern_help, routing matching cases to the pattern_help specialist with the obligation on the case.
The premium_experience audit feeds the premium_standard consumer; the requirement is to exceed the best purchased experience, enforced at publish.

Video teardown findings become enforce.video_specification, emitted daily by the cadence; a product with a video asset is held to it at publish, one without is not_applicable. No Brambleloop video exists yet.
The materials audit binds both the PDF (explanation) and Pattern Help (validation questions) through the same enforce and triage path.
The packaging audit binds the delivery_bundle consumer, enforced at the publish gate against our self-audit.

When benchmarks disagree by 3+ points, a 'clarify' requirement is created on the support consumer and checked against the shop package FAQ and policy text we publish; unmet requirements block publish; promotions now flow (C-62 fixed).

TeardownFinding gains confidence and raw_notes columns, captured through the audit and finding routes, lab and scorecard. Confidence below 0.5 makes a requirement provisional (listed but not blocking).

Teardown proposals carry the self_audit trial, measured against our own product's audit: the first audit anchors the baseline, a later better one earns TESTING, tests and promotion. Execution adopts a floor enforced on every product; a lower later audit reverts it.

registry.DECLARED_IO gives every agent inputs, outputs and a per-function metric; swarm.orchestrate.function_quality computes it from rows; a weak function turns an agent's verdict to 'watch' in swarm.review.

work_items reads CoverageGap, BenchmarkProduct, Listing, Experiment, SupportCase, OwnerAction and TeardownFinding, each with an owner check; swarm.orphans surfaces unowned ones as incidents, and the weekly cycle adds a steward when 3+ are unowned.

improve.role_work uses roles.activity_from_db: proposals the role authored, the ones kept, and realised uplift from improve.roi after promotion; the evaluator reports its confirmation rate; experiment_designer reads experiments and open proposals.

Replays of historical tasks with fresh holdout days run on the improve.replay cadence and in the nightly sweep; challengers compared under league.compare (holdout and margin), promoted only when they beat the incumbent, rolled back on fresh data.

priority_for(job_type, inputs, db) is used at every enqueue. A deadline or value moves a job up to 4 points inside its band; unproven listing work goes to new_opportunity. The weights come from the league-promoted scoring policy.
The pipeline processes real proposals: the replay is a simulation, pre-authorised tiers auto-promote, and higher tiers (e.g. a code-tier teardown change) go to the existing owner card path.
The nightly CHALLENGERS stage runs replay.cycle, recording 7 runs and 6 comparisons, instead of counting ConfigVersion rows.

Conversion, ads, support and cost are read from ListingOutcome, Cohort and CostEntry, SupportCase, and CostEntry and Ledger rows (UNMEASURED when empty). ADD-specialist changes are generated and carded. Not built: automatic metric revision (REVISE_METRIC is never generated).
The publish gate (release_gates.standards_gate) compares every raised CompetitiveStandard (gallery images, video, sizes) with the listing's own reading; below the bar or unmeasured blocks publish.
mission_runtime.active_veto is consulted by the store.publish gates, by gate.certify (release withheld) and by the asset gate; the owner's latest ruling decides.
mix.next_role (used by ideation) reads concentration; when the alarm is on the top SKU's role is deprioritised and the brief says to build outside its family; bundles and cross-sells stay eligible.

agent_notes: release_gates.for_publish also blocks on owner veto, raised CompetitiveStandard, binding teardown requirements (once a purchased benchmark is audited; unmeasured blocks)
listing work for a product with no attributed revenue enqueues at new_opportunity (70) not proven_winner (40)
findings under brambleloop:<slug> are the self-audit measurement, not promoted hypotheses
test_cert_wiring band test allows the 999 collection wait priority -- the lead's C-73 removed that priority; reconcile at merge
TeardownFinding gains confidence and raw_notes (additive migration)
new cadences improve.replay and teardown.enforce; retention improve.replay.challenger; new modules improve/replay.py improve/consume.py improve/evolution.py teardown/enforce.py
